agents.name: Link to request a Seat Sherpa ride
agents.description: For a rider when no ride fits: a link where the person posts a ride request on Seat Sherpa, the carpool marketplace, so drivers on that route see it and get notified, and the person hears back when a matching ride is posted. Use it after search_rides finds nothing that works (that answer already includes this link), or when the person asks to be told about a trip nobody has posted. Takes the same places and optional date as search_rides. The person signs in and posts the request on the page; this tool only builds the link, posts nothing, and never needs names, phone numbers or emails.
reasons: This capability allows a user to post a ride request on Seat Sherpa, a carpool marketplace, so drivers can see it and respond.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

agents.name: GraceRoad: prepare a request
agents.description: Prepares a request to GraceRoad and returns a link for the user. For 'transport', the link opens GraceRoad's assistant with the request already written; the user sends it themselves. Submitting a transport request carries a study fee (not the transport price); the response states the amount in 'avis_frais' and 'a_dire_a_l_utilisateur'. For 'carburant' (fuel in volume) asking for an offer is free. For 'sourcing', the enquiry is free and a fixed fee is quoted afterwards. This tool creates nothing and charges nothing.
reasons: This capability prepares a request to GraceRoad for transport and returns a link for the user to send.

agents.name: book_ride
agents.description: Crée une VRAIE demande de réservation, transmise à la centrale Taxis Fabbrimone en remplissant et en soumettant le vrai formulaire du site (même circuit que le formulaire du site). Action à conséquence réelle : à n'utiliser qu'après confirmation explicite de l'utilisateur humain, jamais de manière spéculative. Exige un délai d'au moins 12h avant l'heure de prise en charge — refusé sinon. Ne crée pas de confirmation finale immédiate : un accusé de réception est envoyé par e-mail, la centrale confirme ensuite. Aucun suivi GPS en temps réel disponible à ce jour.

agents.name: Create a confirmed RIED.TAXI booking
agents.description: Creates a REAL, CONFIRMED booking in RIED.TAXI's booking system and blocks the day. Only call after the customer has seen the complete trip and price and explicitly said yes. Requires the quote_id, customer_confirmed=true, accepted_terms=true and an idempotency_key (retrying with the same key never creates a second booking). Returns the booking reference and an access code for the customer.
reasons: This capability creates a real, confirmed booking in RIED.TAXI's system.

assessment.explanation: I found several agents that can help with ride requests and bookings. Seat Sherpa allows you to post a ride request for carpooling. GraceRoad can prepare a transport request for you. Taxis Fabbrimone and RIED.TAXI can create real ride bookings. Rovv also offers ride booking. Additionally, Bonis Concierge and another agent can lodge booking requests, and OlaChill can send a charter quote request.
